provenance.origin: Newly authored for this benchmark; not copied from repository examples.
provenance.trainingLeakageClaim: No claim is made that these rules or examples are absent from any model's training data. Repository isolation only proves they are not supplied in measured prompts or candidate workspaces.

rules.statement: The production safety override wins over a user request for pretty logs while preserving a warning.
Port conflict detection uses the environment-derived service default when service.port is absent.
Feature uniqueness is checked after case, whitespace, underscore, and punctuation normalization.
Origin scheme/host canonicalization happens before sorting and duplicate removal.
Exponential maxDelayMs is capped at 60000 after exponentiation, not before it.
